intro: One row per term of the manuals, one column per language. A text taken from the application (its resource files or reference translations, what the screen shows) is written as it is. A text the translators chose is marked **(?)** where they were not sure that a native professional reader would use it; each partner is asked to confirm or correct the terms of its own language. The Turkish terms were approved by a native speaker on 21 November 2026.
